import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))

# Define colors for species
species_colors = {'setosa': '#1f77b4', 'versicolor': '#ff7f0e', 'virginica': '#2ca02c'}

# Scatter plot: Sepal length vs Sepal width
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    axes[0, 0].scatter(species_data['sepal_length'], species_data['sepal_width'],
                      alpha=0.7, s=60, label=species, color=species_colors[species])
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sepal Length vs Sepal Width by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Species', fontsize=10, title_fontsize=11)
axes[0, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Scatter plot: Petal length vs Petal width
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    axes[0, 1].scatter(species_data['petal_length'], species_data['petal_width'],
                      alpha=0.7, s=60, label=species, color=species_colors[species])
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Petal Length vs Petal Width by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Species', fontsize=10, title_fontsize=11)
axes[0, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Box plot: Sepal measurements
sepal_data = pd.melt(df, id_vars=['species'], value_vars=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width'],
                     var_name='Measurement', value_name='Value')
sns.boxplot(x='Measurement', y='Value', hue='species', data=sepal_data,
            palette=species_colors, ax=axes[1, 0])
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Sepal Measurement', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Value (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Distribution of Sepal Measurements by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].legend(title='Species', fontsize=10, title_fontsize=11)
axes[1, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Box plot: Petal measurements
petal_data = pd.melt(df, id_vars=['species'], value_vars=['petal_length', 'petal_width'],
                     var_name='Measurement', value_name='Value')
sns.boxplot(x='Measurement', y='Value', hue='species', data=petal_data,
            palette=species_colors, ax=axes[1, 1])
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Petal Measurement', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Value (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Distribution of Petal Measurements by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Species', fontsize=10, title_fontsize=11)
axes[1, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout and add overall title
plt.suptitle('Iris Dataset Analysis: Flower Measurements by Species', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
